slides.title: Moyale: UN warns needs are growing
slides.body: A new UNHCR update from the Ethiopia–Kenya border

slides.title: people may have crossed into Kenya
slides.body: Local authorities' estimate since Oct 22, per UNHCR. The figure is still changing as registration continues.

slides.title: Many are women and children
slides.body: Some stay with relatives and host families. Others shelter in schools and churches.

slides.title: Food is the most urgent need
slides.body: Also needed: safe drinking water, emergency shelter, sanitation and health care, UNHCR says.

slides.title: people: relief supplies being mobilized
slides.body: UNHCR has sent an emergency team to Moyale and plans to scale up with IOM, UNICEF, WFP and Kenya Red Cross.

slides.title: Safer sites away from the border
slides.body: UNHCR says it is working with Kenyan authorities to find safer accommodation further from the frontier.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Let aid reach them.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
